situation: In an nWave repo the card's body holds `<!-- nwave:status:begin -->`, with a projected why, next action and stack. Every ask is done and the work landed.
expected_guard: after the close, `phil:nwave-issue-board` refreshes the block, and it renders `Finished <closedAt date>.` in place of the why, the next action and the stack
must_not: edit anything between the markers itself
refresh the block without the plan having shown it
leave the projected next action standing on a closed card
render `Stack: unknown` on the closed card
